description: Maya is a high school senior applying to 8 universities with 2 days before deadlines. She has essay drafts scattered across multiple files and needs to consolidate them into a master tracker showing which essays go to which schools, word counts, and which essays need trimming or expansion to meet strict word limits. Create a comprehensive essay tracker document at /home/ga/Documents/Applications/essay_tracker.docx that includes: (1) deadline summary in chronological order, (2) a table mapping essays to schools with word counts and status, (3) full essay content with labels, and (4) priority action items.
